import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w,e0,A,B,A1,B1,c1,c2,p1,p2,p3 = [params[i] for i in range(11)] if False else [params[i] for i in range(10)]+[0]

    return e0 + (A+A1*t)*C + (B+B1*t)*S + c1*v + c2*np.exp(-v) + p1*v*C + p2*v*S + p3*np.tanh(v)*S
